apex.name: Apex
apex.blurb: An Omni taken to its peak: a frame of crimson and gold turning round it, embers rising through it, light sweeping over it.
apex.how: 10 copies of the same Omni card: the card and 9 spares.

relic.name: Relic
relic.blurb: A franchise's relic: a frame of carved stone and gold with a light running round it, a seal of runes turning behind it, runes lighting up one after another, dust drifting in the light.
relic.how: Complete a set and beat its boss on Hell: then pick one card of that set to become its Relic (one per set).

eclipse.name: Eclipse
eclipse.blurb: A card the black hole gave back eclipsed: dark, but for a corona of light burning round its edge.
eclipse.how: A Mythic or Omni swallowed by a pack's black hole may come back Eclipsed. Every other star it swallows leaves a star shard: 7 shards eclipse a Mythic or Omni of your choice.

bond.name: Bond
bond.blurb: A card two friends got together: a frame of their two colours turning, two lights answering each other, and both names on it.
bond.how: Only in Bond packs, opened by two friends together (both must be there). Each day you both play the daily gives your Bond a point; 3 points open a pack. You both get the same 5 cards, and maybe the Bond card, linked to both of you.
